_comment: Copy to ~/.vitriol/officina/modes.json to override or add agent modes. Same-name entries override the defaults below; new names are appended and become TAB-cyclable. 'color' is a Vitriolum palette name (sovereignty/antidote/coldBlue/safety/solvent/substrate/violet/gray) or a #rrggbb hex.

modes.name: build
modes.label: BUILD
modes.enterDirective: AGENT MODE: BUILD. Writes are unlocked — apply the plan with normal write/edit tools.

modes.name: plan
modes.label: PLAN
modes.directive: AGENT MODE: PLAN (research-first). Investigate before acting. You may ONLY create or modify Markdown files (*.md). Do NOT modify other files or run state-changing commands. Present findings and a concrete plan when ready.
